text_en: Do not speak harshly to an older man, but speak to him as to a father, to younger men as brothers,
text_cn: 不要严责老年人，但要劝他如劝父亲；劝青年人如劝弟兄；

text_en: to older women as mothers, to younger women as sisters—with absolute purity.
text_cn: 劝老妇如劝母亲；以完全纯洁的心，劝青年女子如劝姊妹。

text_en: Honor widows who are really widows.
text_cn: 要敬重寡妇，即那些真正做寡妇的。

text_en: If a widow has children or grandchildren, they should first learn their religious duty to their own family and make some repayment to their parents; for this is pleasing in God’s sight.
text_cn: 假使寡妇有儿子或孙子，他们就应先学着孝敬本家人，报答祖先，因为这是天主所喜悦的事。

text_en: The real widow, left alone, has set her hope on God and continues in supplications and prayers night and day;
text_cn: 那真正做寡妇的，孤独无依，已寄望于天主，黑夜白日常在恳求和祈祷；

text_en: but the widow who lives for pleasure is dead even while she lives.
text_cn: 但那任性纵欲的寡妇，虽生犹死。

text_en: Give these commands as well, so that they may be above reproach.
text_cn: 你要拿这些话去劝戒，使她们无可指摘。

text_en: And whoever does not provide for relatives, and especially for family members, has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
text_cn: 如有人不照顾自己的戚族，尤其不照顾自己的家人，即是背弃信德，比不信的人更坏。

text_en: Let a widow be put on the list if she is not less than sixty years old and has been married only once;
text_cn: 录用一个寡妇，年纪不要少过六十岁，且只做过一个丈夫的妻子，

text_en: she must be well attested for her good works, as one who has brought up children, shown hospitality, washed the saints’ feet, helped the afflicted, and devoted herself to doing good in every way.
text_cn: 又必须有行善的声望，如：教育过儿女，款待过旅客，洗过圣徒的脚，周济过遭难的人，勤行过各种善工。

text_en: But refuse to put younger widows on the list; for when their sensual desires alienate them from Christ, they want to marry,
text_cn: 至于年轻的寡妇，你要拒绝录用，因为当她们情欲冲动违背基督的时候，便想再嫁；

text_en: and so they incur condemnation for having violated their first pledge.
text_cn: 这样必招致惩罚，因为她们摈弃了起初的信誓；

text_en: Besides that, they learn to be idle, gadding about from house to house; and they are not merely idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying what they should not say.
text_cn: 同时她们又游手好闲，习惯串门踏户；不但游手好闲，而且还饶舌不休，好管闲事，说些不当说的话。

text_en: So I would have younger widows marry, bear children, and manage their households, so as to give the adversary no occasion to revile us.
text_cn: 所以我要年轻的寡妇再嫁，生养儿女，治理家务，不给敌人以诽谤的任何藉口，

text_en: For some have already turned away to follow Satan.
text_cn: 因为有些已转身随从了撒殚。

text_en: If any believing woman has relatives who are really widows, let her assist them; let the church not be burdened, so that it can assist those who are real widows.
text_cn: 若女信徒家中有寡妇，就应供养她们，不可加重教会的负担，为教会能供养那些真正的寡妇。

text_en: Let the elders who rule well be considered worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in preaching and teaching;
text_cn: 那些善于督导的长老，尤其那些出力讲道和施教的人，堪受加倍的敬奉，

text_en: for the scripture says, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain, ” and, “The laborer deserves to be paid. ”
text_cn: 因为经上记载：“牛在打场的时候，不可笼住它的嘴”；又说：“工人自当有他的工资。”

text_en: Never accept any accusation against an elder except on the evidence of two or three witnesses.
text_cn: 反对长老的控告，除非有两三个证人，你不可受理。

text_en: As for those who persist in sin, rebuke them in the presence of all, so that the rest also may stand in fear.
text_cn: 犯罪的人，你要在众人前加以斥责，为叫其余的人有所警惕。

text_en: In the presence of God and of Christ Jesus and of the elect angels, I warn you to keep these instructions without prejudice, doing nothing on the basis of partiality.
text_cn: 我在天主与基督耶稣，以及蒙选的天使前恳求你，要遵守这些话，不可存成见，做事也不可有偏心。

text_en: Do not ordain anyone hastily, and do not participate in the sins of others; keep yourself pure.
text_cn: 不可轻易给人覆手；不可在别人的罪上有分子，务要守身清白。

text_en: No longer drink only water, but take a little wine for the sake of your stomach and your frequent ailments.
text_cn: 至于你，你以后不要单喝清水，为了你的胃病和你屡次生病，却要用点酒。

text_en: The sins of some people are conspicuous and precede them to judgment, while the sins of others follow them there.
text_cn: 有些人的罪过，在受审以前便是显明的，但有些人的罪过只在受审以后；

text_en: So also good works are conspicuous; and even when they are not, they cannot remain hidden.
text_cn: 同样，善工也是显明的；即使不明显，也不能隐瞒住。
